name: Feel samples
description: Community samples of attachments and a behavior: random landing, stick glide and wander, curved swipes, smoothing, adaptive smoothing, a response curve, a dead zone, hold time and a finger that draws circles.

attachments.name: randomLanding
attachments.title: Random landing
attachments.description: Each press lands at a random spot in a small circle; the moves and the lift of that finger keep the same offset.

params.title: Radius
params.description: As a percentage of the picture's short side.

attachments.name: joystickGlide
attachments.title: Stick glide
attachments.description: When the stick turns, the finger slides to the new place over a short time instead of jumping there.

attachments.name: joystickWander
attachments.title: Stick wander
attachments.description: While the stick is pushed, the finger drifts slowly and at random, like a hand that never holds perfectly still.

params.title: Drift
params.description: As a percentage of the picture's short side.

attachments.name: curvedSwipe
attachments.title: Curved swipe
attachments.description: Bends a straight swipe into an arc: the farther from where the finger went down, the more it bends, back on the line at the swipe length.

params.title: Bend
params.description: Negative values bend to the other side.

params.title: Swipe length
params.description: As a percentage of the picture's short side.

attachments.name: smoothing
attachments.title: Smoothing
attachments.description: Makes the finger follow more softly; higher values are smoother and slower.

attachments.name: adaptiveSmoothing
attachments.title: Adaptive smoothing
attachments.description: A One Euro filter: smooth when moving slowly, quick when moving fast.

attachments.name: responseCurve
attachments.title: Response curve
attachments.description: Changes how strongly sticks and triggers act along a curve: across is how far they are pushed, up is how far that goes on.

attachments.name: deadZone
attachments.title: Dead zone
attachments.description: Ignores small pushes of sticks and triggers; beyond the dead zone the value starts again from zero.

params.title: Size
params.description: The share of the stick's travel that is ignored.

attachments.name: holdTime
attachments.title: Hold time
attachments.description: Keeps every press down at least this long, plus a random extra.

behaviors.name: circle
behaviors.title: Draw circles
behaviors.description: While the key is held, one finger goes round in a circle around the component.

params.title: Radius
params.description: As a percentage of the picture's short side.

zh_CN.name: 手感样例
zh_CN.description: 社区做的附加与按法样例：随机落点、轮盘滑行与拟人偏移、弯曲滑动、平滑、自适应平滑、响应曲线、死区、按住时长，以及一根手指画圈。
zh_CN.attachments.randomLanding.title: 随机落点
zh_CN.attachments.randomLanding.description: 每次按下时在一个小圆里随机挑落点，这根手指之后的移动与抬起都保持同样的偏移。
按画面短边的百分比计。
zh_CN.attachments.joystickGlide.title: 轮盘滑行
zh_CN.attachments.joystickGlide.description: 摇杆换方向时，手指在一小段时间里滑到新位置，而不是一下跳过去。
zh_CN.attachments.joystickWander.title: 轮盘拟人偏移
zh_CN.attachments.joystickWander.description: 推着摇杆时，手指缓慢地随机漂移，像人手一样不会完全静止。
zh_CN.attachments.joystickWander.params.amount: 按画面短边的百分比计。
zh_CN.attachments.curvedSwipe.title: 弯曲滑动
zh_CN.attachments.curvedSwipe.description: 把直线滑动弯成弧线：离按下的地方越远弯得越多，到滑动长度处回到原线上。
zh_CN.attachments.curvedSwipe.params.length.de: 按画面短边的百分比计。
zh_CN.attachments.smoothing.title: 平滑
zh_CN.attachments.smoothing.description: 让手指跟得更柔和；数值越大越平滑，也越慢。
zh_CN.attachments.adaptiveSmoothing.title: 自适应平滑
zh_CN.attachments.adaptiveSmoothing.descriptio: One Euro 滤波：慢慢移动时更平滑，快速移动时更跟手。
zh_CN.attachments.responseCurve.title: 响应曲线
zh_CN.attachments.responseCurve.description: 按曲线改变摇杆与扳机的力度：横轴是推了多少，纵轴是送出去多少。
zh_CN.attachments.deadZone.title: 死区
zh_CN.attachments.deadZone.description: 忽略摇杆与扳机的轻微推动；超出死区后从零开始增加。
zh_CN.attachments.deadZone.params.size.title: 死区大小
zh_CN.attachments.deadZone.params.size.descrip: 摇杆行程里被忽略的比例。
zh_CN.attachments.holdTime.title: 按住时长
zh_CN.attachments.holdTime.description: 每次按下至少按住这么久，再随机多按一会儿。
zh_CN.attachments.holdTime.params.extra.title: 随机加长
zh_CN.behaviors.circle.title: 画圈
zh_CN.behaviors.circle.description: 按住键时，一根手指绕着组件的位置画圈。
zh_CN.behaviors.circle.slots.hold.title: 按住
zh_CN.behaviors.circle.params.radius.title: 半径
zh_CN.behaviors.circle.params.radius.descripti: 按画面短边的百分比计。
zh_CN.behaviors.circle.params.period.title: 一圈用时
zh_CN.behaviors.circle.params.clockwise.title: 顺时针
